metadata.what: One policy, one evaluator, one protocol, three datasets.
why_this_is_a_file: A run described in a script is a run nobody else can reproduce or diff.
Every plane here is named and configured; swapping a dataset, a policy or
an evaluator is an edit to this file and nothing else.
what_is_checked: screen and protocol both declare holds=(policy, evaluation), so the
framework verifies from provenance that those planes really were identical
across the three cohorts before it reports any difference between them.
Without that, 'only the dataset varied' is a claim by whoever wrote the
script rather than a fact about the run.
what_was_refused: The protocol sweep was in this manifest and `gantry plan` refused it:
it needs per-episode outcomes, and neither the LeRobot conversion nor an
offline evaluator has any. That refusal arrived in a second, before any
inference ran, which is the point of planning separately from running.
